name: app
title: app
description:
Upgrade the Daily Mood Logger app into a full web app with both backend and frontend.

Add a homepage at route `/` that serves an HTML interface using Jinja2 templates.
The page should include:
- A dropdown to select a mood (Happy, Sad, Neutral, Angry, Excited)
- A text area to write a short note
- A submit button to log the mood
- A table below that lists the 10 most recent mood logs (mood, note, timestamp)
- A “Clear All” button that deletes all logs

Backend routes:
- POST /log → accepts JSON {mood, note} and saves to mood_log.json
- GET /recent → returns the 10 most recent logs
- DELETE /clear → clears all logs
- GET /moods → returns the list of available moods
Serve static JS and CSS from /static/.

Make the frontend call these routes using JavaScript fetch().
Ensure the page updates dynamically after submitting or clearing logs.
Include minimal but clean CSS styling (centered layout, pastel background).
